summary: Frontend validation of 3 client requests on Galista Café site: (1) open/closed badge legibility in hero/map/infos, (2) removal of 'ingredient confirm' badges from carte in FR/DE/EN, (3) loader with official /logo.png. All three validated as PASS. Tested on desktop 1920 and mobile 375.

test_results.badge_hero_desktop: PASS — [data-testid=open-badge] solid bg rgb(62,155,99), text white 'Ouvert · jusqu'à 17:00' (lundi 26/10/2026), WCAG AA contrast OK
test_results.badge_map_maplibre: PASS — same solid green badge on top-left of MapLibre marker, legible
test_results.badge_infos_row: PASS — solid green badge next to 'Horaires officiels — ...'
test_results.confirm_badges_removed_fr: PASS — 0 'à confirmer' badge in #carte (the single 'à confirmer' hit on the page is hidden text inside #avis tooltip 'valeurs indicatives à confirmer sur la fiche Google' — unrelated to ingredients)
test_results.confirm_badges_removed_de: PASS — 0 'zu bestätigen' in #carte (hit is in #avis section, hidden)
test_results.confirm_badges_removed_en: PASS — 0 'to be confirmed' in #carte (hit is in #avis section, hidden)
test_results.loader_desktop: PASS — [data-testid=loader] shows [data-testid=loader-logo] (/logo.png 200 OK, 96x96, floating), 3D cup, tagline 'LA PAUSE ISTANBULIENNE VOUS ATTEND', progress bar; disappears within ~2.6s with fade
test_results.loader_mobile_375: PASS — loader fits in viewport, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth<=innerWidth)
test_results.regressions: Hero photo + cream text OK, badges solid everywhere, MapLibre loaded, header FR/DE/EN language switcher visible, Nous trouver CTA present

console_warnings_preexisting: MapLibre worker warning (pre-existing, acknowledged in request)
Lenis warning about container non-static position (pre-existing)

404 on malformed Pexels image URL https://images.pexels.com/photos/1540420773420-31ed25ee0cdf.jpeg — looks like a UUID was concatenated incorrectly into the slug; appears to be in a gallery/review image dataset — PRE-EXISTING, not related to this iteration
action_items: (LOW/optional) Pre-existing broken Pexels image URL 'photos/1540420773420-31ed25ee0cdf.jpeg' returns 404 — malformed slug (date-like prefix). Not part of this iteration but worth fixing in a future pass if it's a user-facing image.
critical_code_review_comments: Badge contrast is excellent — white (#fff) on #3E9B63 ≈ 4.7:1, passes WCAG AA.
Loader logo correctly served from /public/logo.png (200 OK, image/png).
The 'à confirmer' phrase remains intentionally in #avis section (review-verification disclosure) and is semantically different from the removed ingredient badge — no action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 client-requested changes validated on https://galista-atelier.preview.emergentagent.com/fr. If re-testing: clear sessionStorage key 'galista-loader-seen' to see loader. Pre-existing warnings (MapLibre worker, Lenis container, broken Pexels URL in avis/gallery dataset) are not regressions.
